atoms.span: BANNEDTHOUGHT.NET - Struggling against the suppression of progressive ideas.

is an online digital archive that collects, preserves, and publishes censored documents, periodicals, and writings related to international communist movements, Maoist theory, and revolutionary left-wing struggles worldwide.
including materials from the Communist Party of the Philippines (CPP), the Communist Party of India (Maoist), and broader Marxist-Leninist-Maoist movements.
It aims to oppose the suppression of progressive or radical ideas by making rare, out-of-print, and politically censored texts freely accessible.

observations.notes: Faithful at the level of purpose and scope. The holder (independent of every party) and the form of the holdings (each split's parties kept in parallel) are the two features the census asks of an archive of the left, and both are absent.
